title: Halcyon Drift Rising
author: I. M. Vasquez
blurb: Xanthe Kavanagh, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
